import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_recurrence_window_unique_endpoint (p q : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h₀ : ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n) (h₁ : a 1 = p) (h₂ : a 2 = 9) (h₃ : a 3 = 3 * p - q) (h₄ : a 4 = 3 * p + q) : ∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ 2009 → ∀ x : ℝ, x = a (N + 1) ↔ x = 5 + 4 * (N : ℝ) := by
  have hpq : p = 5 ∧ q = 2 := by
    have r1 := h₀ 1
    have r2 := h₀ 2
    norm_num at r1 r2
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₃] at r1
    rw [h₂, h₃, h₄] at r2
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hp : p = 5 := hpq.1
  
  have hform :
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        a (n + 1) = 5 + 4 * (n : ℝ) ∧
        a (n + 2) = 5 + 4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        constructor <;> norm_num [h₁, hp, h₂]
    | succ n ih =>
        constructor
        · simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.cast_add,
            Nat.cast_one] using ih.2
        · have hr :
              a (n + 3) - a (n + 2) = a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) := by
            convert h₀ (n + 1) using 1 <;> omega
          have hnext :
              a (n + 3) = 5 + 4 * ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [ih.1, ih.2] at hr
            norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hr ⊢
            linarith
          simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.cast_add,
            Nat.cast_one] using hnext
  
  intro N _ x
  have hf := (hform N).1
  constructor <;> intro hx
  · rw [hx, hf]
  · rw [hx, hf]
